about: Known answers for the komando sealed file (docs/design/sealed-file.md): recipient mode v2 (HPKE base mode, X-Wing MLKEM768-X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM) and passphrase mode v1. Every byte is fixed: seal with the inputs and compare file_hex; open file_hex and compare content and check_phrase. aad is the first aad_length bytes of the file (magic, header length, header). The X-Wing private key is the 32-byte seed; encap_randomness is 32 bytes of ML-KEM-768 m, then the 32-byte X25519 ephemeral private key. Each refused file must fail with its error and give no content.
